nodes.label: Tenant Room Data Model
nodes.rationale: Every restaurant is a tenant in a shared database where tenantId scopes every document across every collection, enforced at middleware level.

nodes.label: POS Offline Batch Sync & Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Batched offline register orders require unique offlineGuid markers to identify and skip duplicate retry transmissions.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Local Environment & Verification
nodes.rationale: Validates environment configuration and infrastructure connectivity before writing application modules.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Tenant & Auth Foundation
nodes.rationale: Establishes tenant isolation, JWT authentication, RBAC, and cross-tenant tests as prerequisite for all domain modules.

nodes.label: Legacy Staging VPS Runbook
nodes.rationale: Retained for historical reference; superseded by Vercel Serverless and QStash deployment.

nodes.label: Interface Layer Principle
nodes.rationale: Business logic only ever calls cacheService, queueService, and realtimeService abstractions to keep the codebase testable and infrastructure swappable.

nodes.label: MongoDB Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: MongoDB is written before Firestore projection layer; Firestore write failures are caught and retried asynchronously via queue.

nodes.label: Tier-Based Tenant Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Redis sliding token bucket quotas per subscription tier to mitigate noisy neighbor problems.

nodes.label: PM2 and VPS Infrastructure Removal
nodes.rationale: Deletes ecosystem.config.js, VPS deploy scripts, and Nginx configs after full Vercel serverless transition.

nodes.label: QStash Serverless Push Queue Migration
nodes.rationale: Replaces long-running RabbitMQ consumers with QStash HTTP webhooks and signature verification on Vercel.

nodes.label: Single Serverless Bootstrap Entrypoint
nodes.rationale: Removes duplicate serverless bootstrap routines to eliminate maintenance drift between api/index.ts and app.ts.

nodes.label: Tenant Middleware Impersonation Rejection Guard
nodes.rationale: Rejects unresolvable impersonation targetId/targetSlug with 404 instead of silently falling through.

nodes.label: Brand vs Storefront Scoping & Compound Indexing
nodes.rationale: Rule #11: Compound indexing on { tenantId, branchId, createdAt } distinguishes brand organization from physical storefront.
nodes.norm_label: brand vs storefront scoping & compound indexing

nodes.label: Domain Event Bus Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Rule #12: Modules must not couple synchronously; broadcast milestones via typed domain event bus.

nodes.label: Mandatory Tenant Scoped Query Helper
nodes.rationale: Rule #1: Every MongoDB query must go through tenantQuery helper to auto-inject tenantId and prevent cross-tenant data leaks.

nodes.label: Zero-DevOps Cloud Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decoupled from legacy Linux VPS, PM2 cluster scripts, Docker containers, and Nginx setups to run natively on Vercel Serverless Cloud Runtime.

nodes.label: Chat Sessions Table Binding
nodes.rationale: Binds Telegram chatId to table context with 30-day Redis TTL so n8n can recover context without managing session UUIDs.

nodes.label: Cryptographic QR JWT Signing
nodes.rationale: Replaces ad-hoc string tokens with cryptographically signed JWTs carrying tenant, branch, and table scopes.

nodes.label: QR Channel DINE_IN Unification & TableId Refinement
nodes.rationale: Normalizes QR self-service orders to DINE_IN and requires tableId conditionally via Zod refine.
nodes.norm_label: qr channel dine_in unification & tableid refinement

nodes.label: Hot vs Cold Order Archival Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Background archival of orders older than 90 days to cold storage to keep real-time operational indexes sub-20ms.

nodes.label: Redis QR Table Session Fraud Prevention
nodes.rationale: Layers 90-min Redis session over permanent QR JWT to eliminate scan-once order-later replay fraud.

nodes.label: Body-Based Tenant Context Requirement
nodes.rationale: Mutating requests require tenantId or tenantSlug in JSON body rather than headers to prevent insecure header spoofing.

nodes.label: Atomic Tenant & Subscription Provisioning

nodes.label: Mongoose Transaction Session Threading Fix
nodes.rationale: Threads session through tenantQuery.create and repository methods to guarantee real atomic rollbacks in MongoDB multi-document transactions.
